==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
A man with short silver hair travels to another dimension. This otherworldly space has a dark crimson sky full of clouds. Throughout the space are massive metal spires and towers.

The man flies into a silver tunnel, where he encounters a faceless green hologram. The hologram seems to draw power from the man, weakening him with blue energy tendrils. The man howls in pain.

In order to defeat the hologram, the man sacrifices his power and his hair changes from silver to black. He came all this way to save his mother from the hologram, but his mother refuses to leave. His mother reveals that the hologram is actually the man's grandfather, so the three agree to live together as a family in this strange world.

Thirty minutes after I woke up from this dream, my UFO detector in my kitchen went off.
